en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Khashhab, from Ibn Baqah, from Muaz Bin Sabit, from Amro Bin Jumie, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Messiah<sup>as</sup> was saying: ‘Do not frequent with the speech in other than the Remembrance of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, for those who are frequenting the speech in other than the Remembrance of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, it is hardening their hearts, but they are not knowing’.
en.sarwar: 11. Hamid ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Khashshab from ibn Baqqah from Mu’adh ibn Thabit from ‘Amr ibn Jami’ from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
Jesus would say, “Do not speak a great deal in things other than speaking of Allah. Those who speak a great deal in things other than speaking of Allah are hardhearted, but they do not know it.’””
